about: Ten made-up long messages to a first mate, each with a hand-labelled list of what was asked. Written fresh as examples: no real chat, no real person. Every text starts with 'Example:'. 'anchor' is the shortest verbatim span (case, spacing and quote marks aside) that carries the ask: a row of the ledger counts as holding the ask when its quote contains the anchor (or the other way round). 'cancelled' asks are asked and then withdrawn in the same message, so they must NOT stay open. 'duplicate' marks an ask said a second time (it should be one row, not two). 'notAsks' are sentences that look like asks but are not Ash's (a pasted customer message), so they must not become rows.

messages.shape: Unnumbered list of fixes in a chatty rant, with a tangent in the middle; one implicit ask, one rule, one question at the end.
messages.text: Example: ok so I've been going through the app all morning and honestly it's mostly fine but a few things are driving me up the wall. The invoice export still drops the last row when there are more than fifty lines, can you fix that. I also noticed the onboarding tour fires every single time I open a fresh window which is annoying, so make it only show once per install. Oh and while you're in there, the settings page says 'Preferances' with a typo. Anyway my sister called halfway through so I lost my train of thought, where was I. Right, the weekly report email, I want it to go out Monday at 8 instead of Sunday night because nobody reads it on Sunday. Also please don't touch the pricing page, that's frozen until Priya signs off. Last thing, tell me which of these you think is the riskiest so I know what to test first.

messages.shape: Think-aloud about releases: the main ask is said twice, one idea parked for later, two standing rules, one question.
messages.text: Example: I was thinking on the train about how we handle releases and I think we're doing too much by hand. Every Friday I end up tagging the build, writing the notes and posting in the channel, and it eats an hour. So let's automate the release notes from the merged PR titles. Maybe, and I'm not sure about this, we could also post them to the changelog page automatically, but park that for now. The tagging should happen when I say 'ship it' in chat and not before. Related: the channel post should tag whoever is on call. I keep forgetting to tell you, always run the full checks before any tag, never skip them even if I'm in a hurry. So yeah, release notes from PR titles, that's the main one. And can you tell me what you'd need from me to set up the on-call tagging, I don't know where that list lives.

messages.shape: A pasted customer message holds asks that are NOT Ash's; four real asks follow it.
messages.text: Example: Dana from Kestrel Foods wrote in and I want us to handle it properly. Her message was: 'Hi team, the export keeps timing out for our big accounts. Please fix this before month end. Can you tell us when it will be done? Thanks, Dana.' So, reply to Dana today and say we're on it and give her a date by Friday. Then look into the export timeouts, I suspect it's the same thing as last month, the query without the index. Also check whether any other big accounts have hit it, search the logs for the last two weeks. And write me a short summary of what happened that I can forward to her account manager.

Do the same fix on the other page, you know the one, the one with the long table. Mia asked whether we can support single sign on by March, find out what that would take and tell me.
